description:
Goal
Make the compiler2_pull_ tests prove the product path, not parity with a pre-settled legacy TransportPlan. Current tests drive the old transport plan and then seed product requests from plan.executable_membership, which hides whether the product path can discover demanded work itself.

Signal
The 00181 pull tests start from a root product demand or exact product keys reachable from the product session. They no longer call drive_until_transport_plan, no longer read TransportPlan(root) to discover executable membership, and still prove main/0 returns {int,int}, Kernel.+/2 stays direct arity-2 callable transport, no first-class callable boundary is published, and final inventory contains the expected demanded roles.

Strategy
Rewrite the tests around RootBackendProduct(root), product telemetry, and request-local inventory. Where a lower-level product needs a seed, derive it from the product under test or from explicit fixture facts already demanded by that product, never from the old root plan.

Removal target
Delete or quarantine test helpers that exist only to force old transport/root artifact jobs before product assertions.

Verification
cargo test -q --lib compiler2_pull_; rg in product tests shows no drive_until_transport_plan/TransportPlan membership setup except explicitly legacy tests.
title: Pull tests: stop pre-settling legacy transport plans
